description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “69 E Trigger Trail”. A stunning, brand-new vacation home nestled in the heart of Seacrest Beach, just minutes from the Gulf. With room for 16 guests, a designer kitchen, firepit, and a third-floor balcony complete with an outdoor kitchen, this 4 private suite + bunk room retreat delivers a luxurious yet laid-back beach escape. Learn more below... 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS *** Brand-New Build in Seacrest Beach — Coastal charm meets elevated comfort Sleeps 16 — 4 private bedrooms + queen-over-queen bunk room Luxury Kitchen — Marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, island seating for 4, dining for 6 Private Outdoor Spaces — First-floor firepit lounge and third-floor balcony with outdoor kitchen Access to 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool — Resort-style pool with zero-entry splash zone and waterfalls Private Beach Access — 7-minute walk or quick tram ride to white sand shores 7 Adult Bikes Included — Cruise the trails to Rosemary Beach, Peddler’s Pavilion & more Walk to Live Music, Dining & Shops — Only 2 minutes to Peddler’s Pavilion*** LIVING AREAS *** Bright and spacious living room with plush seating Smart TV for movie nights or game-day vibes Seamless access to outdoor patio with cozy firepit and seating for 4*** KITCHEN & DINING *** Marble countertops & full suite of stainless steel appliances Large island with seating for 4 Dining table with seating for 6 Third-floor balcony with built-in grill, mini fridge, and flat-screen TV for al fresco entertaining*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Half Bath: Conveniently located off Kitchen Area2nd Floor: Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, private En-suite with dual vanities & walk-in shower King Guest Suite: King bed, shared Jack & Jill bath (dual vanities, walk-in shower) Bunk Room: Two Queen-over-Queen bunk beds, shared Jack & Jill bath with King Guest Suite3rd Floor: Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, private En-suite with single vanity & walk-in shower Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private En-suite with single vanity & walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR OASIS *** First-floor patio with cozy firepit and seating for 4 Third-floor balcony with built-in grill, mini fridge & flat-screen TV Ideal for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or starry night chats*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY *** Lagoon Pool: 12,000 sq ft of fun with waterfalls and zero-entry splash zone Private Beach Access: Just a 7-minute walk or short tram ride away Peddler’s Pavilion: 2-minute walk to shopping, snacks, and live music 2-minute bike ride to Rosemary Beach Explore 30A’s scenic trails, dune lakes, and iconic beach communities*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment Waiver required to get access to 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach. There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the home.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
